propositions: binding_store.py exceeds 787/800 LOC cap with only 13 lines of headroom, risking CI build failure on next contributor change

last-synced peer state functions (baseline and peer-parent getters/setters plus _BASELINE_FIELDS) form a distinct ~130 LOC cohesive concern that should be extracted to a new module to reduce binding_store.py below 700 LOC
peer_state cluster has its own ADR (0026), absence semantics, and advance site in reconcile pass, with no coupling to binding lifecycle or file persistence logic
extraction must preserve BindingStore public surface via thin delegating methods so no call site or test double requires editing and reconciler suites pass untouched

peer_state functions must be directly unit-testable without constructing a BindingStore and must include tests pinning absence-semantics properties (absent baseline degrades to local-wins, absent peer-parent degrades to NO CLEAR)
